fields.label: Stage
fields.description: Copied from the template at plan creation, or typed when added for this style specifically.

fields.label: Source Template Stage
fields.description: Blank when this stage was added for this style rather than seeded from a template.

fields.label: Added For This Style
fields.description: Drives the 'added' badge in the workspace and drift reporting against the template.

fields.options:
Blocked
Not Started
In Progress
Closed - Approved
Closed - Dropped
fields.label: Status
fields.description: Derived from dependencies and version state on every plan load/version event - see sampling.recompute_stage_status(). The only value ever set directly by a user is Closed - Dropped.

fields.label: Closure Date
fields.description: Set automatically when status becomes Closed - *. Cannot precede the latest version's decided_on.

fields.label: Depends On
fields.description: JSON list of stage_name values within this same plan - a per-style-editable snapshot of the template's dependency rule for this stage.

fields.label: Owner
fields.description: Editable per style, independent of the template's owner_role default.

fields.label: Contributors
fields.description: Read+write on this stage's versions (see the module's permission model).

fields.label: Colourway
fields.description: Free text - relevant for lab dips and colour-specific rounds. See the module's material-sample exception note for why this stays free text in the PoC.
